## Synopsis

Prints the named stored PolicySet: a header with the server's own facts
(status, drift, the four posture buckets, recording) on stderr, and the
stored YAML byte-exact on stdout, so `show <name> > copy.yaml` is a clean
export with the story still on screen.

```
strazactl policy show <name> [flags]
```

## Options inherited from parent commands

```
      --server string   strazad base URL (overrides $STRAZA_SERVER and the server you logged into)
```
